```{r }

library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(pscl)
library(datawizard)
library(DHARMa)

```


```{r }

#Read in influence data and team member characteristics

infl <- fread("***Add filepath for Team_influence_data***")

char <- fread("***Add filepath for Team_member_characteristics_updated***")

infl_dat <- merge(infl, char, by = c("Unit", "ResponseId")) %>%
  mutate(Unit = as.character(Unit)) 

infl_dat


#group mean center predictor variables

infl_dat_center <- ungroup(infl_dat) %>%
  mutate(Expertise_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Expertise)), Similarity_to_Mean_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Similarity_to_Mean)), SpeakingTime_scaled = as.numeric(scale(SpeakingTime)), WorkContributions_scaled = as.numeric(scale(WorkContributions)), Dominance_scaled = as.numeric(scale(Dominance))) %>%
  group_by(Unit) %>%
  mutate(Expertise_scaled_center = as.numeric(center(Expertise_scaled)), Similarity_to_Mean_scaled_center = as.numeric(center(Similarity_to_Mean_scaled)), SpeakingTime_scaled_center = as.numeric(center(SpeakingTime_scaled)), WorkContributions_scaled_center = as.numeric(center(WorkContributions_scaled)), Dominance_scaled_center = as.numeric(center(Dominance_scaled))) %>%
  ungroup() 

infl_dat_center


#select most influential team member

infl_dat_center_most <- group_by(infl_dat_center, Unit) %>%
  summarize(Norm_diff = min(Norm_diff)) %>%   #select group member with lowest normalized distance to team track
  merge(., infl_dat_center, by = c("Unit", "Norm_diff")) #merge data back with full dataset to pull in the most influential individual's characteristics

infl_dat_center_most

```

```{r }


#Read in team performance data in design phase and round to nearest integer

perf_dat <- fread("***Add filepath for Performance_data***") 

team_perf <- filter(perf_dat, Trial.Type == "Team", Phase == "Design Phase") 

team_perf_round <- mutate(team_perf, Score_round = round(Score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Unit, Score, Score_round)

team_perf

infl_perf <- merge(infl_dat_center_most, team_perf_round, by = c("Unit"))


```


```{r }

#Visualize histogram of team performance data 

hist(infl_perf$Score, breaks = 20)

hist(infl_perf$Score_round, breaks = 20)

```

```{r }

head(infl_perf)


c <- zeroinfl(Score_round ~ Expertise_scaled + SpeakingTime_scaled + Dominance_scaled + Expertise_scaled:SpeakingTime_scaled + SpeakingTime_scaled:Dominance_scaled + WorkContributions_scaled + Similarity_to_Mean_scaled | 1, data = infl_perf)

summary(c)

```



```{r }

head(infl_perf)


c2 <- zeroinfl(Score_round ~ Expertise_scaled + SpeakingTime_scaled + Dominance_scaled + WorkContributions_scaled + Similarity_to_Mean_scaled | 1, data = infl_perf)

summary(c2)

```



```{r }


#Calculate team performance relative to median brainstorming performance

head(perf_dat)

med <- filter(perf_dat, Trial.Type == "Team", Phase == "Brainstorming Phase") %>% 
  group_by(Unit) %>%
  summarize(med_Score = median(Score)) %>%
  ungroup() 

perf_dif <- dplyr::select(team_perf, Unit, Score) %>%
merge(., med, by = c("Unit")) %>%
mutate(Perf_dif = Score - med_Score) %>%
  dplyr::select(Unit, Perf_dif)

perf_dif


```


```{r }


infl_perf_dif <- merge(infl_dat_center_most, perf_dif, by = c("Unit"))


#Visualize histogram of performance difference data (Team Performance - median individual brainstorming performance)

hist(infl_perf_dif$Perf_dif)


```


```{r }

e <- lm(Perf_dif ~ Expertise_scaled_center + SpeakingTime_scaled_center + Dominance_scaled_center + Expertise_scaled_center:SpeakingTime_scaled_center + SpeakingTime_scaled_center:Dominance_scaled_center + WorkContributions_scaled_center + Similarity_to_Mean_scaled_center, data = infl_perf_dif)

check_model0 <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = e)

hist(residuals(check_model0))

testUniformity(check_model0)  #KS test   

testOutliers(check_model0)
testDispersion(check_model0)  #Dispersion test
testQuantiles(check_model0)

summary(e)

nrow(infl_perf_dif)

```

```{r }

e2 <- lm(Perf_dif ~ Expertise_scaled_center + SpeakingTime_scaled_center + Dominance_scaled_center + WorkContributions_scaled_center + Similarity_to_Mean_scaled_center, data = infl_perf_dif)

check_model0 <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = e2)

hist(residuals(check_model0))

testUniformity(check_model0)  #KS test   

testOutliers(check_model0)
testDispersion(check_model0)  #Dispersion test
testQuantiles(check_model0)

summary(e2)

```
